note: Proposed queue items (queue.py schema) from workstream A2. IDs are provisional (A2-n): renumber on merge. All depend on the Phase 2b campaign finishing; none may run while it holds the GPU.

items.title: Doc-level clean-val scoring of every qualifying Phase 2b checkpoint (primary metric, K9 subsets, memorisation gap)
items.why: Phase 2b addendum A2: the primary metric is bits/char on val docs with < 80% 13-gram overlap (K9). Needs the GPU (K8 scorer).
items.note: 4 scorer calls per checkpoint (clean80, dup80, clean50, dup50), about 1-2 min each at 14M params. Writes experiments/stats/doclevel/<run>.json.

items.title: REPLICATION-stats: paired CIs, TOST, Holm, memorisation gap, MDE on the Phase 2b runs
items.why: Pre-registered secondary layer; the registered rules stay the decision rule.

items.title: SQ111: seed noise at the K7 horizon (E1 3e-3/6e-3 and E10 2e-3/3e-3, seeds 1-2, 20M tokens)
items.why: K7 picked LRs from single runs; E1's 6e-3 vs 3e-3 gap (1.47%) is about 2x the expected seed noise (C156).
items.note: Needs a campaign file written by the main agent (A2 does not touch experiments/launch).

items.title: SQ110: init x data-order factorial for E1 (20M tokens, 3x3) after adding --data-seed to gogeta/train.py
items.why: Separates init from data-order variance: decides whether paired-seed analysis beats Welch.
items.note: The code change must be committed and tagged first; blocked by the campaign's clean-code rule until Phase 2b ends.
